# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.

Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. - `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.

### Test Coverage

Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.

Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.

- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. - **Title**: gh-850 [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-850` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3

- **Deletions**: -7
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T05:42:37Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T05:42:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Read input context:

callers/callees of changed symbols,

impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. ## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

    '        if (!result) return null;',

    '            try { return JSON.parse(result); } catch (e) { return null; }',
    '        }',
    '        return result;',
    '    }',
    '    // Defaults = each helper catch-branch: active/green fail OPEN,',
    '    // verdict/newest fail CLOSED (null).',
    "    var out = { active: false, verdict: null, green: false, newest: null };",
    '    try {',
    '        var res = cli_execute_command({',
    "            command: 'gh api \"repos/' + args.repo.owner + '/' + args.repo.repo +",
    "                '/actions/workflows/' + args.ciWorkflow +",
    "                '/runs?head_sha=' + args.headSha +",
    "                '&event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=5\"'",
    '        });',
    '        var parsed = mcpParse((res || {}).output || (res || {}).stdout || res);',
    '        var list = (parsed && parsed.workflow_runs) || [];',
    '        var now = Date.now();',
    '    // active — hasActiveDispatchedRun semantics: any queued/in-progress/',
    '    // waiting/pending run, or a completed one whose CONCLUSION is younger',
    '    // than the 15-min check-visibility grace.',
    '        out.active = list.some(function (r) {',
    "            if (r.status === 'queued' || r.status === 'in_progress' ||",
    "                r.status === 'waiting' || r.status === 'pending') return true;",
    "            if (r.status === 'completed') {",
    '                var endTs = r.updated_at || r.created_at;',
    '                var age = now - new Date(endTs).getTime();',
    '                return age >= 0 && age < 15 * 60 * 1000;',
    '            }',
    '            return false;',
    '        });',
    '    // green — hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun semantics: any completed run with',
    '    // conclusion success on this head (a canceled run leaves no verdict).',

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. - **Updated**: 2026-10-11T05:42:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.

- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

## PR Description

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.

Closes #850
### Root Cause
- The `ai_validated` latch was consumed as a **per-PR** attribute at query level: `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green` excluded any latched PR via `notLabels`, so a PR whose head moved onto a CI-absent sha (no completed-green dispatched run on the current head) matched no rule and never re-validated — live fa #1457 (2026-10-11 02:59–05:09Z), unwedged only by manual `gh pr edit --remove-label ai_validated`.
- gh-842 covered the zombie-carrying head; gh-850 is the zombie-free but CI-absent head. Invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` (`validate_pr`): gh-850 **latch VOID** — latch present but no completed-green dispatched run covering the current head → auto-strip `ai_validated` (the operator surgery, automated) + guarded re-dispatch. **Latch economy** for non-`skipIfValidatedHead` rules: a covering green on the current head still skips re-validation even when the REST rollup reads `none`/`pending` (fa #762 invisible-rollup shape), replacing the removed query-level exclusion.
- `sm_github.json`: dropped `ai_validated` from `notLabels` of `validate-fresh` and `validate-fresh-masked-green`; rule descriptions document the per-head-sha contract. `validate-armed` latch-skip with a covering green is unchanged (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- `test_smAgent.js` — new suite `gh-850 latch VOID` (5 tests): AC1 dev-lane via real `githubSource` query, AC1 masked-green dead-zone, AC1 approved-lane strip, AC2 covering-green economy (invisible rollup), AC3 L2 replay of the #1457 timeline (dispatch+strip tick → green conclusion re-latches). Updated the masked-green config hygiene pin.
- RED first: all 5 failed pre-fix. Full suite: **2509 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- Strip is best-effort (warn-only on API failure); the dispatch re-validates regardless and `complete_validation` re-latches on the new green.
- Sweep/mergeBot untouched — the SM tick owns label reconciliation; the gh-821 zombie sweep still owns armed-PR recovery.

# gh-850: [GOAL] Latch-skip deadlock: ai_validated survives head moves with no covering CI → tick stamps in-progress forever, never re-dispatches (live fa #1457 05:0x, unblocked by manual label strip)

## Description

## Goal

Fix the latch-skip deadlock: a PR with `ai_validated` latched whose head MOVED (refresh/rebase/reset) and now carries NO CI run at all (no check-runs on the current sha) is skipped by validate-armed (latch present), never CLEAN (required check 'expected'), not matched by dead-zone (wants existing green checks) — the tick stamps 'in-progress' forever and never dispatches. Operator workaround (verified live fa #1457 2026-10-11 05:0x): strip `ai_validated` → tick arms validation within seconds → dispatch.

## Rule change

Latch-skip (and ai_validated in general) must REQUIRE a covering condition: a completed-green dispatched CI run ON THE CURRENT HEAD SHA. Absent → ai_validated is void for this head (auto-strip or treat as not-validated; do not require operator label surgery). The gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID covers the zombie-carrying head; THIS covers the zombie-FREE but CI-absent head. Both shapes share the invariant: validation latches are per-head-sha, never per-PR.

## Live evidence

fa #1457 2026-10-11 02:59-05:09: heads 0f320340/4799a12/856a145 each carried green-or-no runs, ai_validated latched from an older head; tick log loops '📍 stamp in-progress pr#1457' with NO dispatch (last dispatched run stayed on an older sha). After manual `gh pr edit 1457 --remove-label ai_validated` the tick armed ai_validating within seconds (verified 05:10Z).

## Acceptance

1. AC1: head moves on an ai_validated PR with no covering CI on the new sha → next tick dispatches validation without operator action.
2. AC2: existing latch-skip behavior unchanged when a green run DOES cover the current head.
3. AC3: L2 replay of the 05:0x #1457 timeline.

## References

gh-842 (ghost evidence + the false 'fresh stamps override ghosts' assumption — also still live in the engine's rule text; see comment 2026-10-11), gh-848 (minter), fa #1457.
